reasonForRestriction: Research evidence is permitted, but this work is excluded from the White Day Cafe public exhibition collection under the project's subject-display policy.
evidenceRules: A collected Wang Xizhi glyph in Huairen's compilation is evidence for transmitted Wang-form vocabulary, not direct evidence of Wang Xizhi's original local phrase context.
Keep Huairen compilation context distinct from the unknown or different source context of the collected Wang glyph.
Do not infer original ink pressure from stele/rubbing transmission.
Use the evidence for structure, component treatment, stroke-path hypotheses and variant comparison; downgrade claims about original ink dynamics.
A TC001 character remains unresolved until the exact occurrence and surrounding inscription context are verified.
Restricted research evidence must never make its parent work eligible for White Day Cafe exhibition.

nextGate.name: restricted-candidate-context-verification
nextGate.requirement: Verify exact inscription occurrences and local text context for 是、智、慧、端 through remote source metadata/transcription before promoting any candidate into TC001 research evidence.
